# Welcome! {.unnumbered}

## Welcome to an introductory R workshop for REU students 

This workshop is designed to serve as an introduction to R, data wrangling, and data visulatization. Since we only meet on a biweekly basis, it is adivsed that you continue to work on the skills on your own time. 

In this document, I will share all of things we have dicussed and start to share new things. I will update this document every week with a *recap* section. While the code in this document is not interactive, you can copy and paste it into your own script. In addition to this document, I will provide raw data scripts with minimal annotations, since the code will match what is shared here. 

This course will be entirely focussed on **R**. While there no required IDE, I encourage you to start with R studio. Links to R and R Studio downloads ar here: 

Additionally, while **Github** fluency is not required, I will be sharing scripts and data via Github, so please create a username and send it to me via slack.
